description: Defines the VideoFrame class representing a color-converted RGB video frame, including its properties, memory layout, and methods for data access.

classes.name: VideoFrame
classes.description: Represents a color-converted RGB video frame with methods for managing frame and ICC data, including size calculations and data pointers.

methods.name: VideoFrame
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a VideoFrame object with specified parameters and calculates buffer sizes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the VideoFrame with a copy and optional ICC data.

methods.name: getFlattenedSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the flattened VideoFrame including frame and ICC data.

methods.name: getFlattenedData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the frame data within a flattened VideoFrame.

methods.name: getFlattenedIccData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the ICC data within a flattened VideoFrame.
